title: Quenching, washing and tempering equipment for a 1-tonne-per-hour mesh-belt line
summary: Line output requires coordinated heating, oil cooling, de-oiling, washing and tempering. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s mesh-belt line proposal dated 31 May 2024 explicitly qualifies approximately 1000 kg/h as quenching-and-tempering capacity and gives operating times and speed adjustment for different sections. That figure is not directly carburising capacity, and quench-furnace heating power alone cannot establish line output.
